snapshot.title: WatchItems streaming RPC
snapshot.description:
Implement `WatchItems` (server stream) in the service and the Connect handler (currently Unimplemented): every create, update and delete, including outside reloads once watching exists, is pushed to subscribers as `updated` ItemInfo or `deleted_id`.

Subscribers must not block writers (buffered channel per subscriber; a slow subscriber is dropped and reconnects). The GUI uses it for live updates.
